title: About
author: @lunokjod
description: Who is behind this, and what this system is made of: the libraries of `lib/`, each one with its version, its folder, its licence and the sentence it says about itself. The list pages itself with a row of dots and a slide, so a library is never behind a sentence: tap one to see its own page, and Back —or a pinch, or three presses, or three taps— to come home.
